name: Portfolio Holdings
query:
SELECT
  cph.security AS "Security:Link/CF Security",
  cs.security_name AS "Security Name:Data",
  cs.isin AS "ISIN:Data",
  cs.stock_exchange AS "Exchange:Data",
  cs.country AS "Country:Data",
  cs.region AS "Region:Data",
  cs.subregion AS "Subregion:Data",
  cs.sector AS "Sector:Data",
  cs.industry AS "Industry:Data",
  cph.quantity AS "Qty:Float",
  cs.currency AS "Currency:Data",
  cph.average_purchase_price AS "Avg Buy Price:Currency",
  cs.current_price AS "Current Price:Currency",
  cph.current_value AS "Current Value:Currency",
  cph.allocation_percentage AS "Alloc %%:Percent",
  cph.profit_loss AS "P/L:Currency",
  cph.profit_loss_percentage AS "P/L %%:Percent",
  cph.dividend_yield AS "Div Yield %%:Percent:95",
  cph.yearly_dividend_income AS "Div / Year:Currency",
  cph.total_dividend_income AS "Div Total:Currency",
  cs.suggestion_conviction AS "Evaluation Conviction:Data",
  cs.suggestion_action AS "Suggestion:Data",
  cs.rating_moat * 10 AS "Moat:Data",
  cs.rating_management * 10 AS "Management:Data",
  cs.rating_financials * 10 AS "Financials:Data",
  cs.rating_valuation * 10 AS "Valuation:Data",
  cs.rating_industry * 10 AS "Industry Trend:Data",
  cs.suggestion_rating * 10 AS "Overall:Data",
  cs.suggestion_fair_value AS "Fair Value:Currency",
  cs.suggestion_buy_price AS "Buy Below:Currency",
  cs.suggestion_sell_price AS "Sell Above:Currency",
  cs.evaluation_stop_loss AS "Stop Loss:Currency",
  cs.trailing_eps AS "Trailing EPS:Currency",
  cs.forward_eps AS "Forward EPS:Currency",
  cs.earnings_yield AS "Projected Earnings Yield %%:Percent"
FROM `tabCF Portfolio Holding` cph
LEFT JOIN `tabCF Security` cs ON cs.name = cph.security
WHERE
  cph.portfolio = %(portfolio)s
  AND (
    IFNULL(%(region)s, '') = '' 
    OR LOWER(cs.region) LIKE CONCAT('%%', LOWER(TRIM(%(region)s)), '%%')
  )
  AND (
    IFNULL(%(sector)s, '') = '' 
    OR LOWER(cs.sector) LIKE CONCAT('%%', LOWER(TRIM(%(sector)s)), '%%')
  )
ORDER BY cph.allocation_percentage DESC, cs.security_name ASC;
